_README: Extra locations the LLM Usage tab scans for Codex rollout transcripts.
`codex mcp-server` - the binary Claude delegates to - runs under WSL, so the
rollouts for every MCP delegation land in /home/<user>/.codex/sessions, not in
the Windows profile. QI_Dashboard runs as LocalSystem and has no WSL session,
and \\wsl.localhost is not reachable from Python here either - so those files
are mirrored onto C: by engine/common/usage_codex_wsl_sync.py and read from the
mirror. Without this entry the ChatGPT column counts only Codex Desktop and
Paths are scanned in order, before the Windows profile. Duplicates across roots
are harmless - events dedup on the vendor's response_id.
QI_CODEX_EXTRA_ROOTS (semicolon-separated) adds roots without editing this file.

codex_wsl_sync.note: Run it to refresh the mirror. The state file - not an exit code - is the health signal; the dashboard reports its age so a stopped mirror shows as stale rather than as a quietly shrinking number.
